Centre for AI ExcellenceCentre for AI ExcellenceDriving innovation through the power of AI, data, and intelligence to improve industries, economies, and societies.We are advancing the responsible use of AI, data, and digital technologies to serve society, drive industry transformation, and prepare countries and regions for the intelligent era.Artificial intelligence and digital technologies hold immense potential to drive innovation, economic growth, and societal progress. Yet their rapid evolution is outpacing institutions, exposing industries and communities to fragmented governance, uneven access, and underrealized impact.Our mission is to serve as a future-oriented, global platform to accelerate the responsible application of AI, data, and intelligence for the secure, equitable, and collaborative transformation of industries, economies, and societies, ensuring a net-positive impact for people and the planet.700+Organizations engaged20+Governments engaged70+ Innovators and startups engagedOur pillarsThe Centre’s work is structured around three strategic pillars.Accelerating impactful AI innovation and adoptionDriving the shift from pilots to scaled AI deployments with measurable outcomes. This includes next-gen capabilities and innovations that deliver societal value across sectors.Preparing countries and society for the Intelligent EraHelping countries develop inclusive, intelligent economies by building digital infrastructure, cross-sector partnerships, and future-proof strategies.Advancing trustworthy technology and effective governancePromoting safety, transparency, and accountability through forward-looking frameworks and multistakeholder cooperation.Our initiatives on AI, data, and digital technologiesAI Global Alliance (AIGA)This initiative is advancing the safe, equitable, and responsible development of AI. AIGA fosters collaboration across sectors and borders to address governance challenges, shape international norms, and scale real-world solutions that align AI innovation with societal needs.Technology Convergence InitiativeOur community is exploring how AI and other intelligent technologies interact and evolve across digital, biological, and physical systems. The initiative identifies combinatorial innovation patterns, new value chains, and strategies to scale cross-technology solutions.Global Coalition for Digital SafetyThe public-private platform driving global coordination to address online harms, including disinformation, child exploitation, and extremist content. The Coalition promotes best practices, policy frameworks, and collaborative interventions for safer digital environments.Connected Future InitiativeThis initiative focuses on the integration of AI, XR, and other intelligent systems into the broader internet experience, furthering our next phase of connectivity, commerce, and communications, including the agentic web. Our impactMINDS: The trusted global platform for advancing frontier technology innovationThe World Economic Forum programme showcasing how businesses are leveraging technology innovation to create measurable impact and address critical industry and societal challenges.Tech Convergence: Mapping the future of industry through emerging technologyThe 3C Framework identifies 23 high-potential technology combinations across eight critical domains, helping industry leaders unlock new business models and drive system-level transformation across energy, healthcare, infrastructure, and more.Our reportsArtificial Intelligence...The AI Energy Readiness Compass: Aligning AI Ambition with Energy System RealitiesAs AI infrastructure rapidly scales, digital and energy-system decisions are becoming increasingly interconnected. Electricity consumption at AI-focused data centres is expected to triple by 2030, making coordination across governments, utilities, industry and communities essential to achieving competitive, resilient AI outcomes and closing AI energy readiness gaps. Readiness requires matching AI ambitions to an ecosystem’s capacity to support competitive, net-positive development while reinforcing, rather than burdening, existing systems. Developed by the World Economic Forum with Accenture, The AI Energy Readiness Compass: Aligning AI Ambition with Energy System Realities offers a practical methodology for moving from individual ambition to collective action. It guides stakeholders through five steps: assessing constraints and innovations, engaging actors, evaluating strategic choices, building an action plan, and monitoring and adapting as conditions evolve. Drawing on real-world examples, the report shows how stakeholders can shape AI and energy development together to strengthen energy systems and generate inclusive value. Join the AI Energy Impact Global Community to apply the Compass, share insights and help shape more inclusive AI scaling.20 November 2026Digital Trust and SafetyThe Future of Information Integrity: Charting a Global Path in a Fragmented WorldReliable information underpins economies, institutions and societies, yet the systems that sustain it are undergoing transformation. Generative artificial intelligence, algorithmic curation, declining institutional trust and shifting media economics are reshaping how information is created, consumed and distributed. These changes are increasing the scale and complexity of manipulation, weakening trust and challenging the foundations of a reliable information ecosystem. The Future of Information Integrity: Charting a Global Path in a Fragmented World examines information integrity as a systemic challenge across four interconnected layers: creation, consumption, design and distribution, and ecosystem incentives. Through illustrative case studies, potential interventions and future horizons, the report explores how to potentially strengthen the conditions that enable trustworthy information. The report emphasizes the need for coordinated action across governments, industry, media and civil society to build an information ecosystem that preserves openness, supports human agency and ensures reliable information remains accessible, diverse and sustainable.11 November 2026Digital Trust and Safety...Children’s Safety and Well-Being in the Age of AI: Best Practices and IncentivesArtificial intelligence is becoming part of how children learn, create, communicate and play, offering new opportunities for education, accessibility and creativity. At the same time, generative, conversational and agentic AI can introduce or intensify risks through personalization, persuasion, memory and increasingly autonomous action. Protecting children thus requires an approach that advances safety alongside agency, privacy, inclusion, development and human connection.30 September 2026Financial and Monetary Systems...The AI Playbook for Financial ServicesRecent advancements in generative and agentic artificial intelligence (AI) are reshaping financial services at an intense pace.
